name: Forge 1
description: Incendiaire du Jugement déclenchant des conflagrations incontrôlables dans les rangs adverses ravageant les positions fortifiées.

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered anti‑radiation tarps fashioned into a ritual toga, crude rusted metal plates bolted to exposed ribcage, asymmetrical limb mounts with visible implants, a collar of bone fragments and sealed capsules glowing faintly, tumour‑lit patches on skin emitting radioactive yellow luminescence.
loadout.arsenal: High‑tech relic plasma incendiary cannon – a perfectly smooth, geometric weapon grafted into the mutant’s forearm, its barrel emanating intense blue‑violet energy, the core pulsing with radioactive yellow fire, chained to the wrist and fused with bone.

attitude.behavior: Lurching forward with a grotesque, uneven gait, one massive arm raised as the relic cannon erupts, spewing uncontrolled infernal flames that consume fortified positions, ash and embers swirling around the figure.
attitude.emotion: Zealous, ecstatic fury; an expression of divine mania mixed with pain as the fire razes all.

palette_names.name: Radioactive Yellow
palette_names.role: tumor glow, flame accents, energy pulses

palette_names.name: Pure White
palette_names.role: high‑tech relic core and sleek weapon lines

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dynamic multi‑source: radioactive fire casting harsh orange‑yellow rim light, relic weapon emitting blue‑violet glow, ambient ash dust illuminated by flickering flames.

camera.angle: Low angle with a slight Dutch tilt to emphasize looming stature

scenography.setting: Destroyed fortified bunker on a scorched wasteland, charred walls, twisted metal debris, pools of radioactive sludge.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Flames licking the air, embers and ash swirling, faint radioactive haze, blue‑violet energy crackling from the relic weapon, dust clouds illuminated by the fire.
